# Pixel Coin Collector — Procedural Asset Pack

**Every asset in this folder was generated by Python scripts** (`_tools/*.py`, Pillow).
Nothing was drawn by hand. Re-run any script to regenerate or tweak (colors, sizes, seeds).

- Native tile size: **16×16**. Character/enemy cells: **32×32**. All PNGs are 1 px = 1 texel RGBA.
- Sprite sheets are plain grids (frame order left→right, then top→bottom).
- `previews/*Nx.png` files are just upscaled looks-better copies for checking — do NOT import those into Godot; use the 1× sheets.
- In Godot 4 set: *Import → Texture → Compressed* off is fine, but importantly
  **Rendering → Textures → Default Filter = Nearest** (or per-sprite `texture_filter = NEAREST`).

## Folder layout
```
pixel_art/
├─ characters/          player_{default,snow,beach}.png   4×2 sheet of 32×32
│                        row0: idle0 idle1 jump collect | row1: run0..run3
│                        (sprites face LEFT; flip with scale.x = -1)
├─ coins/               coin_{classic,snow,beach}.png     6-frame 32×32 spin cycle
│                       gem_milestone.png 4×32×32 | heart.png 32×32 | coin_pile.png 48×32
│  └─ effects/          fx_coin_ring / fx_coin_sparkle / fx_poof  (4 frames, 16×16)
├─ enemies/             slime_{green,snow,lava}.png       5×2 grid of 32×32
│                        row0: idle0-3 + move0 | row1: move1-3 + hit0-1
├─ worlds/
│  ├─ classic_meadow/   tiles.png (8×16px): grass dirt stone grass-top blade water brick wood
│  ├─ snow_town/        tiles.png (8×16px): snow-ground underground ice-water drift brick plank cobble deco
│  │                    pine_tree(32×48) pine_cluster(64×48) snowman(32×40) icicles(32×16)
│  │                    present_crate(24×24) milestone_sign(48×32)
│  └─ beach/            tiles.png (8×16px): sand wet sea rock dock pebbles grass foam
│                        palm_tree(48×64) crab.png(6×32×24 walk+claw-snap) shell_pink/yellow(24×24)
│                        starfish(24×24) umbrella(32×48) barrel(24×24) waves.png(4×48×16)
├─ props/               bush_small/large(32×24) rock_small/large(24×24) stump(24×24)
│                       flowers_red/blue.png (4×16×16 sway anim) cloud_prop(48×24) wooden_sign(32×32)
├─ backgrounds/         parallax_{classic,snow,beach}_far.png 320×180 | menu_bg.png 640×360
├─ weather/             snowflake, snowflake_big, bubble, leaf (8×8 particles)
├─ ui/                  panel_ninepatch(48×48, margin 6) btn_green/red/blue(48×20)
│                       hud_coin_counter(64×20) hearts_row(3×16×16) progress_bar(96×16)
│                       icon_skin_* (24×24) font_retro_sheet.png (A–Z 0–9, 8×10 cell)
└─ previews_all/contact_sheet.png    quick visual overview of everything
```

## Using a sheet in Godot 4 (example: player)
```gdscript
# AnimatedSprite2D -> SpriteFrames
# texture = res://pixel_art/characters/player_default.png
# hframes = 4, vframes = 2 ; idle loop = cells 0-1, run loop = cells 4-7,
# jump = cell 2, "collect" pose = cell 3
```
For TileMaps use `worlds/<name>/tiles.png` with a 16×16 TileSet atlas (8 columns).

## Regenerating / customizing
```bash
pip install pillow
python _tools/gen_player.py      # skins & animations
python _tools/gen_coins.py       # coins, gem, heart, pickup FX
python _tools/gen_enemies.py     # slimes
python _tools/gen_classic_tiles.py / gen_snow.py / gen_beach.py
python _tools/gen_props.py / gen_ui.py
python _tools/make_manifest.py   # rebuild MANIFEST.txt
```
Palettes/sizes live in dicts at the top of each script (`SKINS`, `SLIMES`, `WORLD`) —
edit them and re-run to get recolored variants (e.g. new unlockable skins are one dict entry away).
`MANIFEST.txt` lists every file with exact pixel dimensions.
